title: 牛津教授算了一笔账：热泵电动车只用三成能源，电气化效率优势藏不住
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So electrification allows us to use clean energy that doesn't require the combustion of fossil fuels.
segments.zh: 电气化让我们能用清洁能源，无需燃烧化石燃料。

segments.en: Then on the other hand, you have these huge efficiency advantages of electrification, heat pumps, electric vehicles use, maybe a third or a quarter of the energy that combustion technologies use.
segments.zh: 另一方面，电气化有巨大效率优势，热泵、电动车可能只用燃烧技术三分之一或四分之一的能源。

segments.en: Electricity is not something new, but all of a sudden, electricity powered devices seem to be winning over the masses.
segments.zh: 电不是新事物，但突然间，电动设备似乎赢得了大众青睐。

segments.en: In Europe, battery installations have grown 75% in the first six months of this year.
segments.zh: 在欧洲，今年前六个月电池安装量增长了75%。

segments.en: While in the Philippines, electric car sales have risen 150%.
segments.zh: 在菲律宾，电动汽车销量增长了150%。

segments.en: Even in the US, where the government is clearly against the transition, electric car sales are rising again.
segments.zh: 即使在美国，政府明显反对转型，电动汽车销量也在再次上升。

segments.en: Oh, and Ferrari came out with an electric car. Two mixed reviews, you should google it.
segments.zh: 哦，法拉利推出了电动汽车。评价褒贬不一，你可以谷歌一下。

segments.en: Yet, despite the good news, there are still plenty of obstacles to electrification, which I'm hoping to unpick on today's show.
segments.zh: 尽管有好消息，电气化仍有许多障碍，我希望在今天的节目中剖析。

segments.en: My guest today is Jan Rosinau, Professor of Energy and Climate Policy at Oxford University, where he spends a lot of his time thinking about how energy systems work and how to make them better.
segments.zh: 今天的嘉宾是Jan Rosinau，牛津大学能源与气候政策教授，他花大量时间思考能源系统如何运作并改进。

segments.en: His answer is championing electrification, and not because he wants to, but because he has the numbers and the analyses to back it. This is Zero Ayam Akshadrati. Today, the case to electrify faster.
segments.zh: 他的答案是倡导电气化，不是因为他想，而是因为有数字和分析支持。这是Zero Ayam Akshadrati。今天，加速电气化的理由。

segments.en: Jan, welcome to Zero. Thanks for having me.
segments.zh: 简，欢迎来到Zero节目。感谢邀请。

segments.en: So, you're a big proponent of electrification. That's what we're going to talk about.
segments.zh: 你是电气化的坚定支持者，这正是我们要讨论的。
